item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 05/Dec/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Winds will be weak over the coast of Guangdong today. A surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach southern China during the day on Wednesday. There will be one or two rain patches and temperatures will fall slightly over the region. Under the influence of a dry continental airstream, it will be mainly fine over Guangdong in the following couple of days. An easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong over the weekend. It will be cloudier with a few rain patches over the region.
